Build 45 (Windows) failed in test_a_crafted_file_writes_only_into_the_chosen_folder: a zip written on Windows keeps
«\» in an entry's name as «/», so the design named «C:\Windows\x.ALA» in customer.json was not found (nothing was
written outside the chosen folder — the design was missing). The entries are now looked up with «/» only; the test
has an entry as Windows writes it.
